description: This is a PHP source file handling AJAX requests to set hardware LAN port states related to home security features within a network device management web interface. The script processes user input, interacts with device parameters via backend functions, and returns JSON responses indicating success or failure.

methods.name: getParaValues
methods.description: Fetches parameter values from the backend for specified device objects and attributes.

methods.name: setStr
methods.description: Sets a string value for a specified device parameter path in the backend.
